mapper.insert: INSERT INTO index_jobs() VALUES(#{id},#{repositoryId},#{jobType},#{status},#{currentStep},#{executionMode},#{fallbackReason},#{failureCode},#{errorMessage},#{startedAt},#{heartbeatAt},#{timeoutAt},#{finishedAt},#{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,current_step=EXCLUDED.current_step,execution_mode=EXCLUDED.execution_mode, fallback_reason=EXCLUDED.fallback_reason,failure_code=EXCLUDED.failure_code, error_message=EXCLUDED.error_message,started_at=EXCLUDED.started_at,heartbeat_at=EXCLUDED.heartbeat_at, timeout_at=EXCLUDED.timeout_at,finished_at=EXCLUDED.finished_at
mapper.select:

SELECT DISTINCT j.id,j.repo_id,j.job_type,j.status,j.current_step,j.execution_mode,j.fallback_reason,j.failure_code,j.error_message,j.started_at, j.heartbeat_at,j.timeout_at,j.finished_at,j.created_at FROM index_jobs j JOIN repositories r ON r.id=j.repo_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON p.repo_id=r.id AND p.account_id=#{accountId} WHERE #{admin}=TRUE OR r.owner_account_id=#{accountId} OR p.account_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM index_jobs WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND status IN('QUEUED','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')

SELECT
FROM index_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND job_type IN('FULL','INCREMENTAL') ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1

WITH candidate AS(SELECT id FROM index_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND job_type IN('FULL','INCREMENTAL') ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE index_jobs job SET status='RUNNING',current_step='scan_repository',started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM candidate WHERE job.id=candidate.id RETURNING job.*

WITH candidate AS( SELECT id FROM index_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND job_type=#{jobType} ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE index_jobs job SET status='RUNNING',current_step=#{initialStep},started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, timeout_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{timeoutSeconds}) FROM candidate WHERE job.id=candidate.id RETURNING job.*
mapper.update: UPDATE index_jobs SET current_step=#{currentStep},heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')

UPDATE index_jobs SET status='FAILED',current_step='timed_out',failure_code='CODEGRAPH_TIMEOUT', error_message='CodeGraph 后台任务超过固定执行时限',finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_type=#{jobType} AND status IN('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND timeout_at IS NOT NULL AND timeout_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
